Readers and writers for the files of day-to-day statistical and economic
work, in one place. *lazer* sounds like *læser*: reading is most of what
it does, and it checks what it reads.

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("dataniel/lazer")
```

## What it looks like

``` r
library(lazer)

# Many files at once, in most formats; bind them, keeping the source
panel <- read_files("data/dat{2020:2024}.parquet", names = 2020:2024,
                    out = "bind", .id = "year")

# Every sheet of a workbook, the table found on each sheet
sheets <- read_workbook("data/report.xlsx")
sales  <- read_workbook("data/report.xlsx", range = "Salesdata")   # a named range

# Presentable Excel output
write_excel(list(Overview = overview, Detail = detail), "out.xlsx")

# Greenlandic supply and use table files (SUT, in Danish TA), both layouts
sut <- read_sut("ta19l")                          # version recognised
write_sut(sut, "ta19l_new", version = 2)
convert_sut("ta19l", "ta19l_v2", to = 2)
```

The readers share a few habits: quiet when all is well, every problem in
one message instead of one rerun per problem, and nothing dropped or
reinterpreted without a word.

## Functions

| Function                                                                                                                                          | Purpose                                                                                                                                  |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [`read_files()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_files.md)                                                                        | Read many files at once (csv, parquet, Excel, SAS, Stata, SPSS, JSON, YAML, …), and optionally bind or unpack them                       |
| [`read_workbook()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_workbook.md)                                                                  | Read every sheet of a workbook, finding the table on each, or chosen ranges, named ranges or Excel tables; warn about cells left outside |
| [`inspect_excel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/inspect_excel.md)                                                                  | List the blocks of cells outside the table in a workbook                                                                                 |
| [`write_excel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/write_excel.md)                                                                      | Write presentable xlsx: bold, frozen header and readable number formats; create, append or replace sheets                                |
| [`read_access()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_access.md)                                                                      | Read from a Microsoft Access database via ODBC                                                                                           |
| [`read_sut()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_sut.md) / [`write_sut()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/write_sut.md) | Read and write Greenlandic supply and use table files (SUT; TA files in Danish), version 1 (old) or 2 (140 characters)                   |
| [`convert_sut()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/convert_sut.md)                                                                      | Convert a SUT file between the two versions                                                                                              |

## Relation to daos

These functions used to live in
[daos](https://github.com/dataniel/daos). The two packages are
independent; use [`library(lazer)`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer)
for the readers and writers.

# Package index

## Many files at once

- [`read_files()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_files.md)
  : Read one or more files

## Excel

[`read_workbook()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_workbook.md)
finds the table on each sheet;
[`inspect_excel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/inspect_excel.md)
runs its layout check on its own.

- [`read_workbook()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_workbook.md)
  : Read the sheets or tables of an Excel workbook
- [`inspect_excel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/inspect_excel.md)
  : Find cells outside the table in an Excel workbook
- [`write_excel()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/write_excel.md)
  : Write data frames to a presentable Excel file

## Databases

- [`read_access()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_access.md)
  : Read data from a Microsoft Access database

## Greenlandic supply and use tables (SUT)

SUT files, TA files in Danish (tilgang-anvendelse), in both layouts:
version 1 (old) and version 2 (140 characters).

- [`read_sut()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/read_sut.md)
  : Read a Greenlandic SUT file
- [`write_sut()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/write_sut.md)
  : Write a Greenlandic SUT file
- [`convert_sut()`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/convert_sut.md)
  : Convert a Greenlandic SUT file between the two layouts

## Package

- [`lazer`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/lazer-package.md)
  [`lazer-package`](https://dataniel.github.io/lazer/reference/lazer-package.md)
  : lazer: read and write the files an economics team works with
